# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest published release is supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| Latest  | :white_check_mark: |
| Older   | :x: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please do not open a public issue first.

- Please use GitHub private vulnerability reporting for this repository:
	https://github.com/chentao1006/sidey/security/advisories/new

Please include:

- A clear description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Any suggested fix or mitigation

You can expect an initial response within **3 business days**.

After validation, a fix will be prepared and released as soon as possible.
Contributors who report valid vulnerabilities responsibly will be credited unless they prefer to remain anonymous.
